ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - Fast Reverse Proxy (FRP) Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of Fast Reverse Proxy. frp is a fast reverse proxy to help you expose a local server behind a NAT or firewall to the Internet.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\frpc\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\frps\\\.exe$")) OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\frpc\\\.ini.*") OR (process_hash = RGX(".*MD5\\=7D9C233B8C9E3F0EA290D2B84593C842.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*SHA1\\=06DDC9280E1F1810677935A2477012960905942F.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*SHA256\\=57B0936B8D336D8E981C169466A15A5FD21A7D5A2C7DAF62D5E142EE860E387C.*")))
